thread:
maya: quick heads up — opened a PR for migration + recipe snippets for the Optimize recommendations (batching, caching, quant profiles). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789

sam: nice, thanks. where do we want the SDK snippet to live? under /guides/ or /sdk/recipes/?

liam: put the long explanation in /guides/migration/optimize-recommendations.md and a short runnable recipe in /sdk/python/recipes.md that links back. users expect a tiny copy-paste example.

maya: agreed. PR currently adds a large YAML-ish table in the guide but no runnable SDK snippets. I can add a minimal Python and TS example if we like.

sam: +1 for minimal. keep the Python snippet very small, e.g.:

```python
import os
from redwood import Client

client = Client(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
# enable low-latency batching profile for a route
client.optimize.configure_batching(route="/generate", profile="low-latency")
# pin a quantization profile on a model alias
client.optimize.pin_quant_profile(model_alias="gptx-3.5", profile_name="int8-ec")
```

liam: that's good. maybe rename the method to `apply_batching_profile` to match existing SDK naming? iirc we use `apply_...` elsewhere. tiny nit. also add a one-line comment about fallbacks if the profile isn't available.

natalie: FYI there's a broken link on the existing optimize page — https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/optimize#quant-profiles 404 (anchor missing). will send a patch to fix anchors.

maya: thanks @natalie and @docs-bot. i'll update the guide to include the anchor and move the big table into a collapsible tab so the recipe shows first. sam — can you add the updated snippet with `apply_batching_profile` naming?

sam: yep will push a small commit in ~20m. I'll also add a short note about when to prefer KV prefix caching vs full response caching.

liam: also: add a short migration checklist at the top of the guide: 1) audit current batching settings, 2) run evals against quant profiles, 3) test canary on dedicated pool. one sentence each.

maya: perfect. once sam pushes, r? me and @liam for a docs review. target merging before EOD to unblock a customer demo tomorrow.
